race.description: Ladbrokes Wet Season Series Ht 1 Hcp (Bm54)
race.comment: SILVER SMASH (6) is the one to beat coming back from a Sunshine Coast BM68 and Ipswich BM65 form line into this BM54. Her latest sixth reads plain, but she was in the market, had some home-turn manners and contact noted, and her record at 1200m is the key point. Go close. DAMO DAYZ (5) appeals as the immediate danger after a sound first-up fourth in BM58 grade at this track, where he made ground from a difficult position and now has strong distance credentials to lean on. STYLISH PRINCE (4) resumes after eight months off, but his last campaign ended with a Stawell Mdn win and a nose defeat at Kyneton, so the race form is honest enough if he handles 1200m for the first time. ANKLE ROLEX (1) is seasoned, drops out of BM64 grade and has an extensive winning record around this trip, which keeps him in the each-way conversation. PREDICTING (9) next best.
